title: Spiritual Tourism in Uttar Pradesh: Varanasi, Ayodhya, Prayagraj and Braj
seoTitle: Spiritual Places in Uttar Pradesh: Kashi, Ayodhya & Braj | Kudozz Club
metaDescription: Plan a spiritual trip in Uttar Pradesh: Varanasi, Ayodhya, Prayagraj, Mathura and Vrindavan, Chitrakoot and the Buddhist sites, with routes and seasons.
description: A guide to spiritual tourism in Uttar Pradesh: Varanasi's ghats and Kashi Vishwanath, Ayodhya's Ram Mandir, Prayagraj's Sangam, the Braj towns of Mathura, Vrindavan, Govardhan and Barsana, Naimisharanya, Chitrakoot and Vindhyachal, the Buddhist sites of Sarnath, Kushinagar and Shravasti, the Sufi shrines, festivals, routes and seasons.
dek: Uttar Pradesh holds more of Hinduism's most sacred cities than any other state, along with key Buddhist and Sufi sites.

hero.alt: Munshi Ghat and the riverfront of Varanasi on the Ganga

intro: Uttar Pradesh is the heartland of many Hindu pilgrimages: Varanasi (Kashi) on the Ganga, Ayodhya on the Saryu, Prayagraj at the confluence of the Ganga and Yamuna, and the Braj region around Mathura and Vrindavan, linked with Krishna. It also holds three of the great Buddhist sites, Sarnath, Kushinagar and Shravasti, and much-visited Sufi shrines.
The main towns are well connected by rail, road and air. Ayodhya's airport opened in December 2023, and Varanasi, Prayagraj, Lucknow, Gorakhpur and Agra also have airports.
quickAnswer: Uttar Pradesh's main spiritual destinations are Varanasi (the ghats, Ganga Aarti and Kashi Vishwanath), Ayodhya (the Ram Mandir and Hanuman Garhi), Prayagraj (the Triveni Sangam), and Mathura, Vrindavan, Govardhan and Barsana in Braj. Sarnath, Kushinagar and Shravasti are major Buddhist sites. October to March is the best time; Holi in Braj and Dev Deepawali in Varanasi are special but crowded.
takeaways: Varanasi, Ayodhya and Prayagraj form a popular pilgrimage triangle.
Mathura, Vrindavan, Govardhan and Barsana make up the Braj circuit, a short drive from Delhi and Agra.
Sarnath, Kushinagar and Shravasti are three of the great Buddhist sites.
October to March is best; summers are very hot.
Holi in Braj, Dev Deepawali in Varanasi and the Magh Mela at Prayagraj are highlights.

items.name: Varanasi
body: Boat rides at dawn, the evening Ganga Aarti at Dashashwamedh, and Kashi Vishwanath through the new corridor.

image.alt: The gateway of the Kashi Vishwanath Dham corridor in Varanasi
image.caption: Kashi Vishwanath corridor, Varanasi

items.name: Ayodhya
body: The Ram Mandir, consecrated in January 2024, Hanuman Garhi and the Saryu ghats at Ram ki Paidi.

items.name: Prayagraj
body: Boat rides to the Sangam, and the Magh Mela every January and February.

items.name: Braj
body: Mathura's Krishna Janmabhoomi, Vrindavan's temples and parikrama, the Govardhan parikrama and Barsana's hilltop Radha Rani temple.

sections.heading: More sacred places
list: Chitrakoot, on the border with Madhya Pradesh: Ramghat on the Mandakini and the Kamadgiri parikrama.
Vindhyachal near Mirzapur: the Vindhyavasini Devi temple.
Naimisharanya near Sitapur: a forest associated with the telling of the Puranas.
Deva Sharif near Barabanki: the dargah of Haji Waris Ali Shah.

sections.heading: Suggested routes
after: See our Ayodhya, Varanasi and Prayagraj itinerary for day-by-day plans.

sections.heading: Where to stay
list: Varanasi: guesthouses on the ghats for atmosphere, or hotels in Cantonment for easier road access.
Ayodhya: new hotels and dharamshalas near the Ram Mandir and Ram ki Paidi; book early for festivals.
Prayagraj: hotels in Civil Lines; tent camps during the Magh Mela and Kumbh.
Braj: ashrams and guesthouses in Vrindavan, hotels in Mathura.

sections.heading: When to go
list: October to March: the main season; December and January can be foggy, delaying trains.
Holi in Braj (February or March) and Dev Deepawali in Varanasi (November) are special but very crowded.
The Magh Mela at Prayagraj runs in January and February each year.
April to June is very hot; start darshan early.

safety: Darshan waits vary from minutes to many hours; no one can guarantee quick darshan, so plan buffer time.
Dress modestly and follow each place of worship's rules on dress, phones and photography.
Book darshan, aarti and registrations only on official temple or government websites.
Use registered boats at the ghats and wear life jackets where offered.
packing: Warm layers and a shawl for winter mornings

faqs.q: Which are the main spiritual places in Uttar Pradesh?
faqs.a: Varanasi, Ayodhya, Prayagraj, Mathura and Vrindavan, plus Sarnath, Kushinagar and Shravasti for Buddhists.

faqs.q: How many days do I need for Varanasi, Prayagraj and Ayodhya?

faqs.a: By air to Ayodhya's airport, by train to Ayodhya Dham Junction, or by road from Lucknow (about 135 km).

faqs.q: When is the best time to visit Varanasi?
faqs.a: October to March; Dev Deepawali in November is special but crowded.

faqs.q: Can I visit Mathura and Vrindavan from Delhi?
faqs.a: Yes. They are about three to four hours by road, and many people visit on a weekend.
